title: Production Boot Guards Verification
head: d601fdd34
scope: Enumerate + verify every AppServiceProvider::boot() production guard, write completeness sentinel, audit .env.example coverage, identify documented gaps.
verdict_rationale: 10 active production boot guards in AppServiceProvider::boot() are all wired correctly. 5 per-guard dedicated sentinels exist already (POS_SIMULATION, BYPASS×2, IDEMPOTENCY, APP_URL, LOYALTY_QR_SECRET). 1 universal completeness sentinel added covering all 10 + future drift. 1 static sentinel exists for the 11th (DB_LOCK_WAIT_TIMEOUT, non-fatal). All 26 prior + 14 new tests green (40/40 total, 0.242s + 1.786s). .env.example documents every required production var with deploy-checklist context. 1 documented V1.0.X backlog gap (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET — handler returns 500 lazily, acceptable for V1 LOCAL).

guards.exception_message_slice: POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE must be false in production
guards.rationale: NF525 cash-trail bypass — drawer/TPE simulation must NEVER reach production
TPE validation short-circuit — would allow charges without bank approval
TCP/IP thermal printer short-circuit — kitchen would not receive tickets
Leaks stack traces / SQL / DB creds / HMAC context via Whoops — also blocks the SiteService env-edit attack surface

guards.exception_message_slice: IDEMPOTENCY_MIDDLEWARE_ENABLED must be true in production
guards.rationale: 23 mutation routes lose anti-doublon protection — double-charge / double-drawer-open / double-status-change risk

guards.exception_message_slice: LOYALTY_QR_SECRET must be set in production
guards.rationale: Without it, loyalty QR signer falls back to legacy plaintext FK:<code> which is the cross-surface fraud vector being healed (LCS-S-001 / I2-HEAL-03)

guards.exception_message_slice: APP_URL must be set in production
guards.rationale: config/cors.php derives allowed_origins from APP_URL — empty silently rejects /api/broadcasting/auth for kiosk browsers; polling fallback masks the failure

guards.exception_message_slice: BROADCAST_DRIVER must be explicitly set in production
guards.rationale: Real-time KDS/OSS push channels require a non-null broadcaster; /api/health/ready 503s in production when null

guards.exception_message_slice: QUEUE_CONNECTION must not be sync in production
guards.rationale: sync queue executes jobs inline → blocks HTTP requests on DispatchDomainEventsJob (high lane), defeats async outbox + retry-with-backoff
AuditLogService::write uses Cache::lock(audit_chain_b{n}) to serialise NF525 chain inserts across PHP-FPM workers; in-process driver = per-process lock = duplicate-insert race
guards.known_widening_backlog: UNI-03 — comment says 'redis or memcached' but list only blocks ['array','null']. file/database PASS the guard. V1 LOCAL single-box: file driver safe. V2 SaaS ALB multi-instance: widen list. Tracked in PROJECT_BRAIN §8.

guards.rationale: Per-session innodb_lock_wait_timeout cap prevents FPM pool starvation under hot-row contention. Non-fatal: log warning on failure (perf risk, not correctness risk). MySQL-only (SQLite/Pg noop).
guards.note: Universal (runs in all envs), non-throwing — not part of the production-refusal cluster.

missing_from_guard_list.current_behavior: Stripe::handleWebhook() (app/Http/PaymentGateways/Gateways/Stripe.php:204-213) returns HTTP 500 misconfigured + logs stripe_webhook_secret_missing to fiscal channel when the secret is empty. Lazy fallback — provider does NOT refuse to boot.
missing_from_guard_list.v1_local_assessment: ACCEPTABLE — Stripe is not the V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne path. SenangPay + cash + TPE-bypass cover the fiscal happy-path. A misconfigured Stripe webhook would surface as 500s on Stripe Dashboard delivery attempts, not as a silent NF525 break.
missing_from_guard_list.v1_0_x_recommendation: When Stripe becomes a live payment path (V1.0.X+ cloud cutover): promote into AppServiceProvider::boot() guard list with throw new \RuntimeException('STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET must be set in production'). Update completeness sentinel + add dedicated sentinel.

before_first_deploy: [CRITICAL] APP_KEY set via php artisan key:generate
[CRITICAL] POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE=false (guard #1 refuses boot if true — NF525 compliance)
[CRITICAL] LOYALTY_QR_SECRET=<openssl rand -hex 32> (guard #6 refuses boot if empty)
[CRITICAL] BROADCAST_DRIVER=pusher (or redis) (guard #8 refuses boot if null)
[CRITICAL] QUEUE_CONNECTION=redis (or database) (guard #9 refuses boot if sync)
[CRITICAL] CACHE_DRIVER=redis (recommended) or memcached (guard #10 refuses boot if array/null)
[CRITICAL] FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET >=48 chars random (NF525 — AuditLogService refuses to sign if dev-sentinel)
[CRITICAL] FISCAL_Z_REPORT_SECRET >=48 chars random (NF525 — ZReportService refuses to sign if dev-sentinel)
[RECOMMENDED] TIMEZONE=Europe/Paris (NF525 archive cron at 02:00 + now()->subDay() alignment)
[IF USING STRIPE] STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (NOT in boot guard — lazy 500 fallback. V1 LOCAL acceptable per K.8 F-07; V1.0.X cloud cutover should promote into boot guards.)
post_deploy_smoke: curl -fsS https://<your-domain>/api/health/ready (must return 200 — fails if BROADCAST_DRIVER=null OR QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync)
php artisan schedule:list (must show foodking-fiscal-archive-daily at 02:00)
Log spot-check: grep 'production guard' /var/log/php-fpm.log (should be empty — guards only log when bypassed in dev)
Trigger 1 test order → confirm audit_logs row written + fiscal_sequence incremented (NF525 chain healthy)
production_checklist_for_owner.boot_failure_diagnosis: If the app refuses to start in production: tail the PHP-FPM error log — the RuntimeException message tells you EXACTLY which env var to set and the runbook reference. Each guard's exception is self-describing.

rationale_for_completeness_sentinel_over.drift_detection: If a developer adds a new guard to AppServiceProvider but forgets a sentinel, the completeness sentinel naturally lags — but it provides a CANONICAL inventory table that's grep-able. Adding the new guard to self::GUARDS is now a single-place change.
rationale_for_completeness_sentinel_over.shared_priming: primeProductionGood() encodes the canonical known-good baseline once instead of duplicating across 10+ test files.
rationale_for_completeness_sentinel_over.regression_against_reordering: If someone reorders the guards in boot() (sibling could short-circuit earlier), the per-guard tests would silently still pass if their stub is loose; the completeness sentinel asserts the exception message verbatim AND boots from a single primed baseline, so reordering is harmless but inversion is loud.
rationale_for_completeness_sentinel_over.stripe_gap_pin: test_documented_gap_stripe_webhook_secret_not_in_boot_guards uses assertStringNotContainsString — promoting the secret to a boot guard FORCES removal of the gap-pin, preventing 'I added it but forgot the V1.0.X tracking' drift.

low: CACHE_DRIVER guard comment says 'redis or memcached' but only blocks ['array','null'] — file/database PASS. V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-box safe; V2 SaaS ALB multi-instance requires widening. Already tracked as UNI-03 in PROJECT_BRAIN.
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET lazy fallback (HTTP 500 on missing) — V1 LOCAL doesn't use Stripe, so the gap is dormant. V1.0.X cutover should promote.
risk_register.rolled_up_verdict: GREEN — no V1 ship blocker. 2 documented backlog items both bounded by 'V1 LOCAL doesn't trigger' invariant.
